name: Channel Rage [Psionic]
body:
You have learned to focus your anger to fuel your wild
surges.

Prerequisite: Wild Surge class feature, Rage class feature.

Benefit: When you choose to power a manifestation with only your Wild Surge, you may spend 1 round of your Rage instead of expending your Psionic focus.
